earlier_text: We will pay ₹2500 a month to eligible apprentices.
later_text: We will pay ₹2,500 a month to eligible apprentices.

earlier_text: We shall offer a 15 percent rebate on solar pumps.
later_text: We will offer a 15% rebate on solar pumps.

earlier_text: We will waive the licence fee for street vendors.
later_text: The licence fee for street vendors will be waived.

earlier_text: We will enforce the Street Vendors Act.
later_text: We will enforce the Street Vendors Act of 2014.

earlier_text: We will offer free bus travel to secondary school students.
later_text: We will offer free bus travel to secondary school and vocational students.

earlier_text: We will reserve the grant for households earning under ₹2 lakh per year.
later_text: We will reserve the grant for households earning under ₹3 lakh per year.

earlier_text: We will fund a voluntary register of water quality tests.
later_text: We will require a statutory register of water quality tests.

earlier_text: We will complete the drainage upgrades within two years.
later_text: We will complete the drainage upgrades within four years.

earlier_text: We will install one public cooling centre in every district capital.
later_text: We will install one public cooling centre in every municipality.

earlier_text: We will fund community libraries with ₹8 lakh per district.
later_text: We will fund community libraries with ₹12 lakh per district.

earlier_text: We will spend ₹10 crore on drinking water systems.
later_text: We will spend ₹15 crore on district hospitals.

earlier_text: We will pay a maintenance allowance to apprentices.
later_text: We will offer free legal advice to apprentices.

earlier_text: We will extend the rural electricity subsidy.
later_text: The previous government promised to extend the rural electricity subsidy.

earlier_text: We will open five new village health centres.
later_text: We opened five village health centres during our last term.

earlier_text: We will train teachers to use science laboratories.
later_text: We will equip schools with science laboratories.

earlier_text: We will publish the procurement register once a year.
later_text: An annual procurement register will be made public.
